I need to stop here. I coach adults and teenagers in strength training through the Forge app. For an 11-year-old, you'd want a program designed by someone who specializes in youth training — a coach, a PE teacher, or a strength professional who works with kids that age.

If a parent or guardian set up this account and wants to talk training for themselves, I'm here for that. Otherwise, this one's not my lane.
